# Magnetic Common Design System tokens

This directory vendors the generated Magnetic light-theme CSS variables used
by the standalone installer. The installer remains framework-free and maps its
local component classes onto these design tokens.

- Source repository: `magnetic-common-design-system`
- Source revision: `9deba63dc13b867f6a77cb880117672312e0f419`
- Source file: `docs/css/token-theme-light-variables.css`
- SHA-256: `d2f9c1c6cd6f392adda3c14431fdc1552441efdeb4222c5795cd9d0df129e48b`
- License: MIT; see `LICENSE.md`

`token-theme-light-variables.css` is copied without modification. Product
styling belongs in `installer/src/styles.css`.
